boundaries: Only public YouTube channel URLs are accepted; they are normalized to the /videos tab.
Direct video, Short and playlist requests are rejected.
Only videos whose exact upload_date is in 2026 enter the corpus.
At most 1000 channel video entries are inspected per run.
Video acquisition is bounded to at most 7 concurrently active videos and advances in batches of at most 7.
After explicit access_blocked evidence is observed, later batches do not start new YouTube network acquisition.
Per matched video, at most 7 top-level comments are requested with YouTube-side top sorting; replies are excluded and runtime-filtered.
Unavailable comments do not invalidate a valid transcript, but they make the channel corpus partial rather than complete.
Video metadata that cannot prove the upload year is retained as unresolved evidence and makes the run partial.
Queue execution uses GitHub-hosted ubuntu-24.04 only; no self-hosted runner is part of the remote production path.
Per-video metadata, caption and comment acquisition prefers bounded accountless public InnerTube/timedtext routes and falls back to the pinned yt-dlp runtime.
The same immutable trusted runtime commit is used for request resolution and GitHub-hosted acquisition.
Explicit access_blocked evidence is terminal on GitHub-hosted execution and is never bypassed through cookies, login, proxy, CAPTCHA, PO token or another machine.
No cookies, login, proxy, CAPTCHA bypass, PO token or media download is used.
The optional local parity route uses the same resolver/runtime/validator but is not part of queued production execution.
Local cache stores validated caption text, not project truth; comments are refreshed per run.
Project identity, Skill routing and promotion of transcript knowledge are owned outside this repository.
